description: The ENCORE project deposits resource-status data gathered while testing Automated Work Planning Services on JEA renovation works. Zenodo lists five public crew-composition CSV files and nine crew-effort JSON files under CC BY 4.0. The page places the tests between 7 March and 11 April, but does not state the year for this particular deposit. Crew availability and reported effort could calibrate or test building-renovation scheduling simulations that assign crews to tasks over successive days. This is an observed project test, not a general construction labour-capacity survey. The landing page does not define crew roles, effort units, task identifiers or how missing days are represented. Its relation to separate ENCORE activity-status and generated-workplan deposits is conceptual; those have their own addresses and files. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this resource-status release. The CSV and JSON contents were not downloaded, so record counts and whether IDs join across the three deposits remain unverified.
name: Resource status collected during AWOPS tests
notes: G6 item G6-2288. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
